integrity: Every finite comparison is reproducible from exact integer arithmetic; the infinite parts use stated Euler-product, CRT, and Markov arguments. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-sided asymptotic density estimates, not an exact evaluation; finite prime caps and a first-moment bound leave slack; equality-solution infinitude is not considered.
title: A certified \(77\%\)–\(80\%\) bracket for the unitary–exponential divisor-sum comparison
